passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
A psalm is a sacred song or poem.
People use psalms to worship God.
The psalm expresses praise to the LORD.
The psalm declares God's greatness.

passages.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
\r\nSing a new song to the LORD.
\r\nThe LORD has done wonders.
\r\nHis right hand has saved Him.
\r\nHis holy arm has given Him victory.
passages.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה׀ שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־ נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה־ לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has shown His salvation.
He has done this where all nations can see.
The LORD has revealed His righteousness.
He has made His righteousness clear to every nation.
passages.original: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
passages.sermon:
God has remembered His love.
God has remembered His faithfulness.
God has shown this to the house of Israel.
All people everywhere have seen the salvation of our God.
The whole earth has witnessed what God has done to save.
passages.original: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ׀ וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God over all the earth.
All people everywhere must make a joyful noise to the LORD.
Shout with happiness to Him.
Sing out with joy.
Praise Him with your voices.
passages.original: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Sing praises to the LORD.
Use the lyre to make music.
Play the harp as you sing.
Let your song be melodious.
passages.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃

passages.text: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is King.
He rules over all.
Use trumpets to make music.
Blow the ram’s horn loudly.
Shout for joy before the LORD.
Celebrate the LORD with sound.
passages.original: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י׀ הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
passages.sermon:
The sea makes a loud sound.
Everything in the sea joins in.
The whole world joins the sound.
Everyone who lives in the world joins too.
passages.original: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is coming to judge the earth.
The LORD is righteous and fair.
The LORD will judge the world with righteousness.
The LORD will judge all peoples with equity.
The rivers clap their hands.
The mountains sing together for joy.
They rejoice before the LORD.
passages.original: נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־ כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃ לִֽפְֽנֵי־ יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־ תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
